title: On-Time Renewal Credit — Lease Term Agreement Training Questions
content:
**Rule.** A like-program renewal of a Lease Term Agreement earns an on-time renewal credit set by the lease's late fees and autopay enrollment: a lease with no late fee dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before the handling date and with ACH autopay enrolled earns 10.00 dollars a month; a lease with no such late fee and without autopay enrolled earns 5.00 dollars a month; a lease with such a late fee earns no credit. The credit is subtracted from the offered rent in fixing the contracted rent of the renewal.

**Q. Which late fees count?** Late fees posted on the Apartment Home Lease ledger, by the date they were posted, dated fewer than 12 full calendar months before the handling date.

**Q. Which autopay?** Recurring ACH autopay enrolled on the Apartment Home Lease.

**Q. Does a single late fee in the span remove the credit?** Yes. Any late fee in the span leaves no credit, with or without autopay.

| Late fee in the 12-month span | ACH autopay enrolled | On-time renewal credit |
|---|---|---|
| none | yes | 10.00 dollars a month |
| none | no | 5.00 dollars a month |
| one or more | yes | none |
| one or more | no | none |

**Q. Where does the span end? (hypothetical dates)** With a handling date of 3 November, a late fee dated 4 November of the previous year is inside the span; one dated 3 November of the previous year is outside it.
